claims: Every rank-3 matroid has compatible ordered basis-pair exchange diameter at most 3

correctness.evidence: Independent exhaustive basis-axiom filtering found 2053 rank-3 basis families on six elements; exact exchange-graph BFS yielded no disconnected class and maximum diameter 3, with support restriction proving the universal claim.

originality.evidence: Kashiwabara (2010) covers rank-3 White connectivity, but checked exchange-distance literature did not state the sharp universal rank-3 diameter bound 3 or exact small simple spectrum.

value.evidence: The sharp universal rank-3 metric theorem strengthens connectivity and supplies a structural base case for the broader bounded exchange-distance program.

prior_art_qualification.source: Kenji Kashiwabara, The Toric Ideal of a Matroid of Rank 3 is Generated by Quadrics, EJC 17 (2010) R28, DOI 10.37236/300
prior_art_qualification.coverage: Prior rank-3 White connectivity/reachability; not the sharp universal distance bound 3.
